# Beiz Data & Accounting

> AI for real work in Australian businesses, with guardrails, set up and checked by an Australian Chartered Accountant. AI agents with written limits and a person approving what matters, plus AML/CTF, privacy and AI controls, cash models and finance automation, led by Purav Mehta, an Australian Chartered Accountant and GAICD. Beiz connects a business's data, builds cash and job profit models, and sets up AI agents for routine finance work with limits, approvals and a decision log. A person approves anything that touches money, customers or decisions about people.

Key facts:
- Beiz Data & Accounting Pty Ltd, ABN 53 691 755 496. Led by Purav Mehta, Australian Chartered Accountant, GAICD. Based in Canberra, working Australia-wide.
- Fixed scope and fixed price, agreed in writing before work starts. Ways to start: compliance controls sprint from $3,500 (two weeks, one focus: AI use, AML/CTF Tranche 2 or the Privacy Act automated-decision rules starting 10 December 2026; register, data map, named owners, rules and approval points, and a 90-day plan; legal wording stays with the client's adviser or lawyer; no ledger access needed), two-week cash & data check $1,500 fixed (credited if the client goes ahead), live cash & job profit model from $5,000, AI workforce setup from $8,500 (first agent), leave cover from $3,500 setup then from $2,000 a month, then monthly controls operations from $1,250 a month (agent decision review, and AML/CTF screening, monitoring and records where they apply). Other work: quick wins from $1,200. Beiz is not registered for GST, so no GST is added to prices. A written proposal with the exact price follows within three business days.
- Independent: no software of its own to sell. Builds inside the client's own accounts (e.g. Xero, MYOB, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace) using AI plans whose terms exclude training on client data.
- Four disciplines: Data (reconciliation, reporting, forecasting), AI (automation with approval steps), Accounting (management reports, cash forecasts, financial and economic models, profit by job), Governance (board reporting, risk, AI use policy, Privacy Act automated-decision readiness).
- Also offered: a fixed-price billing review of three completed jobs. Timesheets, job list and invoices are reconciled from exports (no logins) into a findings register where each item is Confirmed, Needs information or Explained, with source records and arithmetic. Sample register (made-up data): https://beiz.com.au/assets/media/sample-findings.xlsx
- Typical clients: private-sector businesses of about 5 to 50 staff, especially project businesses that bill time or fixed fees (engineering, IT, consulting, trades).
- Does not provide tax agent, BAS agent, legal, audit or financial product advice services.
- Contact: hello@beiz.com.au, or book a discovery call at https://beiz.com.au/contact/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/beiz-data-accounting/

## Start here
- [Two-week cash & data check](https://beiz.com.au/cash-data-check/): $1,500 fixed; duplicate bills, unbilled hours, invoices below the rate card, unapplied credits and overdue invoices, from exports
- [Compliance controls sprint](https://beiz.com.au/compliance-sprint/): from $3,500, two weeks, one focus: AI use, AML/CTF Tranche 2 or the Privacy Act
- [AML/CTF Tranche 2 for accounting firms](https://beiz.com.au/aml-ctf-accounting-firms/): which services are caught, what firms must do, where agents help and where they stop
- [AML/CTF client onboarding check (interactive demo)](https://beiz.com.au/aml-ctf-accounting-firms/#aml): customer due diligence, screening and the decision a person has to make
- [Free bill check on your own data](https://beiz.com.au/bill-check/): drop in a bills export; possible duplicates, bank detail changes, split bills and ABN problems; runs in the browser, nothing is sent
- [AI running-cost calculator](https://beiz.com.au/ai-cost-calculator/): monthly AI usage cost of an agent in AUD by model, next to the cost of the person who checks its work; vendor prices dated on the page
